beats.action: Minho and Jisoo sit at a table finishing their coffees.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: I already tapped my card under the table.

beats.action: Jisoo narrows her eyes, reaching into her bag.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: Too slow, I pre-paid on the app, Minho.

beats.action: Minho lunges for the waiter, Jisoo blocks his path.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: My card is literally in the machine already!

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: I tipped the waiter twenty bucks to ignore you.

beats.action: The waiter walks over, looking confused.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: Sorry, your payment declined because the card is expired.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: Wait, which one of us is expired?

beats.action: They both sit back, awkward silence ensues.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: I guess we are washing dishes tonight then.

music_prompt: Upbeat, jaunty acoustic jazz with a light percussion rhythm.
caption: POV: You both try to be the hero but end up in the dish pit.

history_entry.core_joke: Both partners try to aggressively pay for the date, only to realize both their payment methods failed.
